nativePolicy: Only idle submit paths are changed. Existing busy-submit behavior remains.
Validate a local candidate history after provider/attachment submission validation and before publishing the new user message.
Pair completed tool results within each preceding assistant tool-call batch using exact case-sensitive IDs. Empty result strings are completed.

Insert one bare role:tool Error result for every unresolved canonical call before its next non-tool boundary or history end. Never dispatch inherited calls, ask approval, or attach copied media metadata to synthesized errors.

IDs reused in separate assistant batches remain valid. Same-batch duplicate IDs, duplicate/unmatched results, malformed call identity/function fields and known-native ID/name/count mismatches reject atomically without appending a user or contacting the provider.

unchangedInterfaces: AgentEngine.h unchanged; queued reply identity/generation callbacks and all existing observer guards retained.

scope: Actual loopback provider requests for OpenAI chat, Responses, Anthropic Messages and Google, plus Google without native IDs.
Native reasoning/signature-bearing fixture fields preserved; completed empty output and metadata preserved; exactly one interruption output per missing call; second submit does not duplicate it.
Repeated call IDs across different historical batches, missing earlier-batch calls, malformed duplicates/orphans/native mismatches and invalid configuration atomic rejection.
An actual source engine waiting for tool approval remains busy and unchanged while its copied target recovers; neither executes an inherited workspace write.
Partial arguments preserved, and direct busyChanged cancellation after recovery retains paired history with no request or tool dispatch.

review.scope: Read-only association, exact IDs, empty output, candidate publication and native ID/order mapping; no additional concrete defect found; no independent test rerun.
Read-only candidate atomicity, batch closure, duplicate/orphan rejection and signed/native preservation; no concrete blocker; no independent runtime or fuzz test.

limits: Fake provider fixtures establish serialized association/order and lifecycle behavior; they do not validate real provider cryptographic signatures or prove acceptance of every interrupted partial-argument payload.
Malformed ambiguous history is preserved and rejected, not silently repaired by inventing IDs or rewriting signed content. No interactive history repair UI is added.
Native history does not persist Stagewise approval-part state taxonomy; every missing native result receives the requested interruption error rather than reconstructing an approval-denial state.
Known native call ID/name/count mappings are validated; canonical/native argument semantic equivalence and unknown native-protocol payloads are outside this targeted recovery check.
Recovery changes the target engine only; parent owns SessionStore persistence and fork/archive/delete UI integration.
Passing this corpus is not a universal correctness or complete Stagewise parity guarantee.
